note: Every printed feature of the flight pack (build_pack.py) with its function, premises, the simpler option considered, its check and when to change it. Guide frame, mm. Premise IDs below; a changed premise means re-reviewing every feature that lists it.

P-FAN.what: ARESWEI HDS001 50 mm 11-blade EDF, parameter set flight_params.FANS['ARESWEI_HDS001'] with tol 1.5 mm on every position and size: stated overall 83.8, lip OD 58.4, rear ring OD 50.8 (pixel 52.9), housing 33.0, motor OD 22.9; pixel duct OD 50.6 (clamp range 49.1..52.5), flare to t 5.4, spinner tip t -12.8, ears t 17.9..27.6 to r 31.5, width 8 (not shown: assumed, +-1.5), leads at t 41..44.5 in any of the four diagonals.
